utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: This matter, Ms. Korner, of the videolink witnesses for January. The e-mail that you would have sent yesterday as to moving those witnesses to the week following when we expected them, we just need to have that formalised in a motion by you that the -- so that the necessary administrative --

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: You mean, it simply won't do for us to arrange it? We have actually got to file a motion to deal with that?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: It can be done orally, certainly.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: I thought we had done that orally. Oh, I see. Oh, right. Well, then, Your Honours, we formally apply to move the videolink witnesses from the week that we had arranged, which I think was the week of the 13th of January, to the following week.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Ms. Korner, as from the planning for next week, you gave us a series of witnesses, and now you are saying that Mr. Trbojevic is coming the week after.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Yes, that's what I told you this morning. I just gave his --

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: He is coming on the -- Tuesday, he will start testifying on Tuesday, the 1st of December.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Because the way I looked into the planning and the estimate times, the witnesses you were speaking about this morning will take more or less two weeks.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: No. Your Honours, the witness who will start tomorrow is 92 ter and will finish on Monday, we estimate.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Yes. Well, my calculation was that you would finish ST-113.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: 113 is one hour in chief, and two hours cross-examination all together. So if does -- he is -- [overlapping speakers]... cross tomorrow. The next one ST-121 who is viva voce is four hours in chief, three and a half in cross. So that's seven and a half hours. That's effectively --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Ms. Korner, this is not the way we -- because you can't follow this orally. Should we exchange the data we have on those? I'll ask the ALO to send you a mail.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Yes, we'll do that. And Your Honours, may I just mention in passing very quickly, Your Honours, may feel in the light of what arose this morning that it may not be a bad idea to have a 65 ter conference at some stage to deal with where we are going effectively, and what we have to do if we are going to have a problem over adjudicated facts in particular. But there are other matters I still think, which at some stage perhaps we might deal with in such a conference. It's just a suggestion for Your Honours to consider.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: I think we, ourselves, had thought so, Ms. Korner. So we'll resume in an hour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Friday, the 20th day of November, 2009, at 9.00 a.m. 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 4.14 p.m.,
